initialBudgetRationale: Re-baselined to the measured Nuxt 4.5 graph (235.95 kB initial, 202.69 kB JavaScript) plus about 1 kB of headroom, and CI now enforces these caps instead of warning. The previous 229 / 192.5 caps were set during the Nuxt 4.5 adoption before the graph was re-measured; the build had exceeded them ever since while CI only warned, so they described an intention rather than the build and caught no regression. An enforced cap at the real number protects against the next regression; ratchet it back down as bytes are recovered. docs/perf-initial-graph.md records the measured composition and the candidate levers, none of which clear the old cap on their own. Re-baselined again from 237 to 240 kB total when app.vue took over the site layout (one persistent <NuxtLayout>, so the header and footer are no longer rebuilt on every navigation). Measured against the previous build (236.94 kB, 0.06 kB under the old cap): +1.79 kB JavaScript for the auth chrome middleware and layout wiring in the entry, CSS unchanged, giving 238.73 kB plus about 1 kB of headroom. The JavaScript and CSS caps are unchanged. Ratcheted down from 240 to 233 kB total and from 204 to 197.5 kB JavaScript on Nuxt 4.6, which ships less client runtime (unctx no longer reaches the browser, and defu is skipped for a single app.config). Measured on the same layer code, Nuxt 4.5.2 built 237.98 kB total and 202.56 kB JavaScript, and Nuxt 4.6.0 builds 231.65 kB and 196.13 kB, so each cap is the 4.6 measurement plus about 1.4 kB of headroom. CSS is unchanged at 35.52 kB, so its 36.5 kB cap stays. The editor-only total grew from 284.92 to 299.35 kB under 4.6's chunking, but its largest chunk (94.27 kB) is well inside the deferred cap. Re-baselined on Nuxt UI 4.12 and motion-v 2.8: Nuxt UI 4.12 cut 4.79 kB of initial JavaScript (197.27 to 192.48 kB) but its theme adds about 1.1 kB of CSS (36.13 to 37.24 kB; new chart tooltip variables and checkbox/radio card variants for every color, which Tailwind keeps because the layer does not use Nuxt UI component detection). motion-v 2.8 grows the deferred domAnimation chunk behind RevealMotion from 26.51 to 29.82 kB; RevealMotion already uses LazyMotion with domAnimation, so there is no lighter import. Measured: 229.72 kB total, 192.48 kB JavaScript, 37.24 kB CSS, 29.82 kB reveal motion. Caps are now 231 total and 194 JavaScript (ratcheted down), 38 CSS and 31 reveal motion (raised), each about 0.8 to 1.5 kB above the measurement. Nuxt UI component detection is the lever for recovering the CSS.
